description: This file contains unit tests for the FrequentEdgeCounter class, which tracks communication patterns between grains in an Orleans-based system. It defines some interfaces for grains and the test class itself with multiple test methods that verify the behavior of edge counting, updating, capacity handling, and removal.

classes.name: FrequentEdgeCounterTests
classes.description: Unit test class verifying the behavior of the FrequentEdgeCounter class, ensuring correct counting, updating, capacity management, and removal of edges in the context of activation repartitioning in Orleans.

methods.name: Add_ShouldIncrementCounter_WhenEdgeIsAdded
methods.description: Tests that adding a new edge increases the counter to 1.

methods.name: Add_ShouldUpdateExistingCounter_WhenSameEdgeIsAddedAgain
methods.description: Verifies that adding the same edge again increments its count.

methods.name: Add_ShouldRemoveMinCounter_WhenCapacityIsReached
methods.description: Checks that when capacity is exceeded, the counter with the minimum count is removed.

methods.name: Remove_ShouldRemoveCounter_WhenEdgeIsRemoved
methods.description: Ensures that removing an edge deletes its counter from the collection.
